name: just
description: For the business you are building with AI: find its name, claim its domain and put its website online. Just Domain checks a name against trademark registers, shows which domain names are available and links to register one on justdomain.ai; searching is free and needs no account. Just Publish puts your site live at a public link, edits it later and helps connect your domain; you sign in once. Nothing is bought in the chat: you register and pay on justdomain.ai.
